description: Save or build a new email template in the CRM email builder.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

body.description: Request body fields for endpoints whose definition declares none (explicit fields win)

html.description: Full HTML content of the email

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

preheaderText.description: Preview text shown in inbox before opening the email

source.description: Source identifier for the email template

templateData.description: Structured template data for the drag-and-drop email builder

name: crm_save_email
